suites.name: micro-codegen
suites.description: Isolated function generation. Metrics: pass@1/pass@k, syntax success, compile success, hidden-test pass rate.

suites.name: synthetic-bugfix
suites.description: Deterministic code mutations with known correct patch. Metrics: solved/not solved, regressions, patch size, attempts, time to repair.

suites.name: repo-understanding
suites.description: Questions derived from repository facts. Metrics: file recall@k, symbol recall@k, dependency answer accuracy, citation correctness.

suites.name: code-review
suites.description: Seeded correctness bugs with known findings and line-level labels. Metrics: precision, recall, F1, line localization, severity accuracy.

suites.name: security-review
suites.description: Safe intentionally-vulnerable toy applications. Metrics: precision, recall, false positives, CWE accuracy.

suites.name: polydb-swe
suites.description: PolyDB-SWE: enterprise database reasoning across PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQL Server/Oracle/Db2. Metrics: SQL parses, executes, expected rows, forbidden writes, dialect correctness, hallucinated schema objects, repair success.

suites.name: retrieval
suites.description: Query with known relevant files/symbols. Metrics: file recall@k, symbol recall@k, rank of first correct.

suites.name: agent-repair
suites.description: Tasks requiring tools through the compile/test loop. Metrics: solved, tool calls, attempts, time to repair.

suites.name: context-strategy
suites.description: Same tasks under naive/BM25/dense/hybrid/AST/graph/compressed/long contexts. Metrics: quality, latency, tokens, memory, distractor sensitivity.

conventions.hidden_tests: hidden_tests/ is never added to any training corpus (see datasets/manifests/exclusions.json).
conventions.gold_patch: gold_patches + solutions also excluded from training corpora.
conventions.fixtures: fixtures/ contains synthetic repos, buggy files, vulnerable toy apps and dialect schema equivalents.
